data.summary_en: RoboRSI uses Top-Down Skill Refinement to decompose tasks into input-output-contract skill branches, attributing execution results to branches to bound revisions; Manager, Planner, Engineer, Reviewer jointly plan/execute/diagnose/verify releases. In simulation, it tops LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, exceeding strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.
